editor.title: Edit Agent
editor.summarization_window_warning: This summarization model has a smaller context window ({summarization}) than the chat model ({chat}), so history compaction may fail earlier.
editor.context_window_invalid: Context window must be a positive number of tokens.
editor.final_prompt_description: Preview the fully assembled system prompt after dynamic tool guidance and skills are injected.
editor.skill_file_not_found: Could not find this skill's file.
editor.plugin_not_enabled: The {plugin} plugin is installed but not enabled.
editor.skills_initializing: Skills are still initializing — try again in a moment.
editor.name_desc: This agent's display name and icon
editor.icon_no_match: No built-in icons match this search.
editor.chat_model_desc: Primary model this agent uses for conversation
editor.no_provider_hint: No AI provider is configured yet.
editor.context_window_desc: Tokens the chat model can take in. Decides when older history is summarized, and for Ollama it is also the num_ctx sent with each request. Filled in from the provider when you pick a model.
editor.context_window_desc_unreported: Tokens the chat model can take in. Decides when older history is summarized, and for Ollama it is also the num_ctx sent with each request. This model's provider doesn't report a window, so set its real limit here.
editor.reasoning_effort_desc: How long the model thinks before it answers. Higher is slower and uses more tokens; lower is quicker. Model default sends nothing. If the model rejects a level, set this back to Model default.
editor.image_input_desc: Send attached images to the chat model. Filled in from the provider when you pick a model.
editor.image_input_desc_unreported: Send attached images to the chat model. This model's provider doesn't report whether it accepts images, so turn this on if it does.
editor.system_prompt_desc: This agent's instructions, including how it uses memory, stored as its own AGENT.md note in your vault
editor.summarization_model_desc: Model used to compress older chat history when the context window fills up
editor.title_model_desc: Model used to generate conversation titles from the first user message
editor.core_skills_intro: Built-in skills every agent can use — vault exploration, note editing, web access, and skill management. Each is a skill: toggle it to attach its tools, or open its note to edit its instructions. Individual tools are configured from the Tools row above.
editor.integrations_intro: Skills backed by your installed community plugins. Each bundles a skill (and, where available, code-scripting) behind one switch.
editor.auto_integration_desc: Auto-discovered plugin exposing a public API. Enabling creates an editable API-scripting skill — the agent introspects the API before calling it. Runs on the main thread (not sandboxed).
editor.subagents_intro: Other agents this one can delegate to via the {task} tool — each subagent runs with its own model, tools, and prompt. Enabling this agent itself delegates to a fresh, isolated-context copy of it (useful for keeping the main conversation clean). Delegation is one level deep (a subagent's own subagents are ignored).
editor.subagent_unavailable: No chat model configured — cannot be used as a subagent
editor.custom_intro: Skills you bring yourself — your own skills and MCP servers.
editor.no_mcp_servers: No MCP servers configured for this agent.

tools.title: Tools
tools.configurable_description: Enable, rename, and configure the individual tools your skills attach. A tool is only usable when at least one enabled skill provides it.
tools.not_attached_badge: Not attached by any enabled skill
tools.always_available_description: Bound outside the skills system, so they aren't configured here — each is controlled by its own setting.
tools.load_skill_desc: Lets the agent load a skill's full instructions on demand. Always available whenever any skill exists.
tools.exec_plugin_desc: Lets the agent script against the {plugin} plugin's api. Controlled in this agent's Integrations section above.
tools.task_desc: Lets the agent delegate a subtask to this subagent. Controlled in this agent's Subagents section above.

tool_config.title: Configure: {name}
tool_config.vision_desc: Configure how images and PDFs encountered during tool use are processed. Auto uses the chat model if it supports vision.
tool_config.image_processor_desc: Vision model to analyze images found in notes.
tool_config.pdf_processor_desc: Vision model for enhanced PDF analysis (charts, tables, diagrams).
tool_config.web_search_provider_desc: Search provider used by this tool. The provider and API key are shared across all agents that enable web_search.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.diff_description: Your version compared with the current default. Edit the note to merge changes by hand, or replace it with the default.
system_prompt.matches_default: This note matches the current default.

add_skill.title: Add Custom Skill
add_skill.error_invalid_skill_md: Invalid SKILL.md: missing name or description in frontmatter
add_skill.description_desc: What this skill does and when to use it. After you add it, the skill's note opens so you can write the full instructions.
add_skill.description_placeholder: Describe when to use this skill...
add_skill.url_desc: Paste a GitHub URL to a SKILL.md file. Supports github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com URLs.

import_error.not_object: Configuration must be a JSON object
import_error.no_entries: No server entries found in the configuration
import_error.multiple: Configuration contains multiple servers — paste one at a time
import_error.no_definition: Could not find an MCP server definition (expected an `mcpServers` or `servers` object)
import_error.stdio: This is a local command (stdio) server. Smart Second Brain only connects to MCP servers over HTTP.
import_error.missing_url: Remote server entry is missing a `url`

mcp.imported_needs_name: Imported from pasted JSON — enter a name for this server.

validation.name_alphanumeric: Name must contain at least one letter or number
validation.duplicate: A server with this name already exists

mcp.name_desc: A name for this MCP server
mcp.url_desc: The URL of the MCP server — or paste the server's JSON config to fill this form
mcp.headers_desc: Optional — one per line, Header-Name: value

status.idle: Enter the server URL — the connection is checked automatically.
status.held: Different host than the saved server — headers are not sent until you {check} or save.

settings.cannot_delete_default: Cannot delete the built-in default agent
settings.heading: Agents
settings.description: Agents combine a model, system prompt, skills, tools, and MCP servers into reusable assistants for different workflows.
settings.agents_folder_desc: Vault folder holding agent context — skills, memories, and base prompts. Changing it seeds the new location; existing files are left in place.
settings.chats_folder_desc: Folder to store chat files and related data
settings.attachment_folder_desc: Folder for chat file attachments. Leave empty to use Obsidian's attachment folder.
settings.status_bar_name: Show active agents in status bar
settings.status_bar_desc: Display a clickable indicator in the status bar for each chat with a running agent.
settings.widgets_folder_desc: Where a widget generated in chat is saved when you click its save button.
